title: komust report.json
description: The lossless, canonical record of a komust mutation run: every mutant with its compile-time facts and execution outcome, plus run metadata. Source of truth for survivors.json and the human report. Additive-only within schema major version 1: this schema does NOT set additionalProperties:false, so a document from a later 1.y (with fields this schema does not name) still validates.

schemaVersion.description: Semver. Within a major, changes are additive only.

mutants.description: Every mutant, sorted by (location.path, location.startLine, id).

operators.description: Operator slugs that produced at least one mutant, sorted.

coveringTests.description: JUnit Platform uniqueIds of the covering test set, fastest-first. The whole selected set for KILLED/SURVIVED; empty for NO_COVERAGE.

testsExecuted.description: How many of coveringTests actually ran — coveringTests.size for SURVIVED, smaller for a fail-fast KILLED, 0 for NO_COVERAGE.

killedBy.description: uniqueId of the first covering test that failed. Present iff status is KILLED.

summary.description: Rendered 'write a test that does X' instruction. Present for SURVIVED and NO_COVERAGE.

status.description: NO_COVERAGE is its own category, never folded into SURVIVED. TIMEOUT is scored as killed but reported distinctly.

startColumn.description: Spike-gated on #2; omitted when the IR pass has no reliable column span.
